preprocessing: Original normalize_data(full raw X) before split, input dtype retained until normalization; then FP32
normal_only_split: Legacy np.random.RandomState(seed) normal-row shuffle: first half train, remaining normals followed by all anomalies test
mixed_setting: All X train, same all X evaluate; transductive
evaluation_replay: Original global evaluation Gaussian draws every 10 epochs; no optimizer changes
batch_size: Closest of 2^3..2^13 to floor(original total N/10), smaller power on ties
auxiliary_RNG: Private seed+1000000; curriculum seed+3000000; independent strong noise seed+4000000
scoring: Original R49 sum of unsquared L2 residual norm over t=1..49; independent corrupted view of original x at each t
aggregation: Within each dataset average seed and scoring bank, then equal-dataset mean; SD ddof=1 over three seed macro means, after bank averaging
